why_not_automatic: Drawings are uploaded and downloaded one item at a time, each with its own creator and DOI; there is no repository to clone and no bulk endpoint, so an offline index cannot be built without a human download.
license_model: source states CC-BY-4.0 for the collection; each imported file must still carry its own recorded license
import_steps: Download the drawings you need from https://scidraw.io (each item page carries its own creator, DOI and license).
Write library/components/scidraw/svg/manifest.json with, per file, {"license", "author", "source_url"} copied from the item page (the DOI link is the source_url).
Run: component_index.py index build --source dir --name scidraw --repo library/components/scidraw/svg
